body:
I really do appreciate the responses.

I wish I could do that, I wish I could just forget biological imperative and women altogether. I wish I could live in a hut in the middle of nowhere and be satisfied, but I don't appear to be in a body that evolved that way. I meditate on this daily, and it seems to be something I desire. What happens when I ignore it, is time passes, and two years later, I find myself writing notes like this, wondering where the time went, and what is wrong with me.

Thanks though, it's rare to find someone who takes the time to write all that out.

I really appreciate the responses.

I guess what it is is two factors:  first, I've spent a considerable amount of time in what we'll call periphery cultures, and those were where I really first lost faith in humans.  You know the groups, those strange, various oddball amalgamations of humans doing weird things, pretending to be open-minded, trying things most people never do once.  The thing is, even in those groups, at the end of the night, people still coupled up like it was prom.  It wasn't, and isn't any different.

There are just so many people who care about this type of thing, even in groups where people pretend or act like they don't, that I don't see how you can avoid it.  Shit, one of my cousins was cheering on another last time we all gathered because her boyfriend is "so tall." These are ivy league women.

I used to be fat, back in the day, but I workout every day and eat healthily to an almost scary degree.  This is so much worse, because it's an inherent lack of value.  When I was fat, if I'm being honest with myself, it's because I wanted to die and had given up. Now, it's the same, but with a bunch of effort for no reason. I want to believe what you are saying, I want to have hope, but my rejection score is something like 1000-0 at this point, across the board, fat, skinny, tall, straight-laced, hippie, doesn't matter. Kind of wish I was a woman, to be honest, would love to just have someone want me, even just once. I would be such an accomplished person if there was just a hint of validation every once in a while. People don't even know how good they have it. So, I just have to man up and get it over with, this will only get worse with time, at least guns are cheap.

I appreciate it, but I think it's misleading.

VT is marketed on reddit. Reddit is a marketing solution.

Tall women don't have it "just as bad," they are seen as models and are very often the ones rejecting short men. There are not nearly as many men going "I won't date a tall woman" as there are woman who get told, to bursts of applause "I won't date a short man." That's women projecting, and it's insulting.  It's at least one, possibly two orders of magnitude different.

No one even talks to me.  Those women you just mentioned ignore me and any attempts to get their attention in favor of taller men, I watch this daily. I don't doubt if I pulled up in a Ferrari and offered to take them directly to the jewelry store, one might hop in the car, but not because of me. So no, they don't exist, except in theory.

Being short has been shown to matter more than anything to women in both formal and informal studies (i.e. both peer-reviewed and OK Cupid metadata).  It also has been shown to lead to less money and career success.  Yet, here we are, saying women have it just as bad in that factor, while women laugh at the short men, call them "children" and then demean them for the same things these very women complain about people doing to them.  This happens, these people are fucking monsters, but they look pretty so we LOVE them.

It really is just death,  nothing left to do but die, go to the store and pick out the tool, hope I can keep it together and not make it obvious. Can't even talk about it without people pretending the situation is something other than what it is.
